turbo.name: Turbo
turbo.blurb: Pulls the car well past its top speed, foot off or not.

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.blurb: A see-through car: pass straight through traffic and barriers.

wrench.name: Wrench
wrench.blurb: Repairs some of your car's health, on the spot.

passenger.name: Inflatable Passenger
passenger.blurb: Makes the shoulder legal: nobody busts you for being on it.

radarDetector.name: Radar Detector
radarDetector.blurb: The police can't bust you, for anything, while it lasts.

siren.name: Siren
siren.blurb: Cars just ahead in your lane pull aside to let you through.

badGas.name: Bad Gas
badGas.blurb: Cheap fuel: top speed and acceleration drop until it wears off.

heavyMass.name: 1000 lb Weight
heavyMass.blurb: A weight in the car: slower, sluggish and harder to steer.

timePlus.name: Time Plus
timePlus.blurb: Puts seconds back on the clock.

armour.name: Armour
armour.blurb: Your car takes less damage while it lasts.

bigSplash.name: Big Splash
bigSplash.blurb: Packages catch every car near where they land.

butterfingers.name: Butterfingers
butterfingers.blurb: You can't throw until it wears off.

cash5.name: $5 Cash
cash5.blurb: Cash, banked with the tip if you deliver on time.

cash10.name: $10 Cash
cash10.blurb: Cash, banked with the tip if you deliver on time.

cash20.name: $20 Cash
cash20.blurb: Cash, banked with the tip if you deliver on time.

target.name: TANK RAGE Target
target.blurb: Land a package on it to find the next piece of the tank.
